issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖יו' means 'his armor-bearer' (the one carrying his weapons/armor), not '自己所拿的器皿之主' ('the master of the vessel he was carrying'). The Chinese rendering misidentifies the subject as 'the master of the vessel' rather than the armor-bearer, changing who is acting and the relationship to Saul.
